positions.name: KnowledgeSuppressionDirective
positions.frame: How does an imperative directive perform authority over what knowledge is retained or purged?
positions.why: Both expressions are imperative commands issued in the same flat, low-arousal register, targeting concrete named artifacts for erasure — one a decision, one a migration. The shared directional read is the performance of authority-ranking: the speaker commands the recipient to alter their cognitive or informational state, deciding unilaterally what is forgotten and what is removed. The relational, power, and value dimensions all converge on this same stance across both segments.
